rules.statement: When, pending execution of the Fiscal's conveyance, a judgment-debtor continues for a long time to be in possession of immovable property sold against him in execution proceedings, the character of his possession may be such as to form the basis of an independent title by prescription, notwithstanding the provisions of section 291 of the Civil Procedure Code.
